svg.title: Every public format, by family: 141 families, 3,698 formats
svg.desc: 141 families of public formats in 11 domains, 3,698 formats in all; each family is shown with its number of packs, counted from packs/. Air: ASTERIX 30, ADS-B 2, OpenSky Network REST API 2, readsb JSON 2, GDL 90 1. Land vehicles: OCPP 2.0.1 128, Waymo Open Dataset 114, CAN DBC (opendbc) 91, OCPP 1.6 78, Baidu Apollo 48, Eclipse uProtocol 33, Tier IV (ROS 2) 13, ASAM OSI (Open Simulation Interface) 12, Autoware (ROS 2) 11, Eclipse KUKSA.val 8, Tesla Fleet Telemetry 5, COVESA VSS 1, OpenXC 1. Sea: NGA Maritime Safety Information 4, Signal K 3, AIS 2, NMEA 2000 2, aisstream.io 1, NMEA 0183 1. Space: Space Data Standards 298, NASA GCN notices 21, CCSDS frames and packets 12, NASA cFE 10, CCSDS NDM/XML 1. Uncrewed systems and robots: ArduPilot DataFlash log 342, PX4 ULog 301, Cyphal (UAVCAN v1) 250, Gazebo messages (gz-msgs) 219, DroneCAN (UAVCAN v0) 133, MAVSDK (gRPC protobuf) 113, ROS 2 interface packages 62, Foxglove 48, Parrot ARSDK 44, Parrot ARSDK protobuf 39, MAVLink 2 14, Open-RMF (ROS 2) 13, VDA 5050 mobile robot interface 8, DRIP (RFC 9575) 1, MassRobotics AMR interoperability 1, Remote ID (ASTM F3411) 1. C2 and tactical: Cursor on Target 2, UCI 2, A-GRA 1, C2SIM 1, Canonical Track v2 1, DIS (IEEE 1278.1) 1, GeoTrackV1 1, NVG 1, STANAG 4676 ISR tracking 1. Sensors: NITF 2.1 32, SBP (Swift Navigation) 22, RoboSense lidar 19, Septentrio SBF 17, u-blox UBX 14, Inertial Sense 10, Ouster lidar 9, ISA 4, STANAG 4607 GMTI 4, MISB local sets 3, OGC SensorThings 2, OGC SWE 2, SAPIENT 2, Velodyne lidar 2, gpsd JSON 1, IGS SSR 1, Livox SDK2 1, OGC Moving Features JSON 1, OGC O&M Simple Features 1, RTCM 3 1, SBAS L1 messages 1, Unicore UNI 1. Transport: GBFS 84, Eclipse SUMO traffic simulation files 41, GTFS Schedule 31, OCPI 17, WZDx 10, Curb Data Specification 8, GOFS 8, TOMP-API 7, OSDM (railways) 5, NeTEx 4, GTFS Realtime 2, hafas-client 2, OpenTripPlanner GraphQL 2, ETSI ITS 1, MDS 1, Valhalla 1. IoT: SunSpec Modbus 112, FIWARE Smart Data Models 93, EVerest charging stack 55, Meshtastic 12, OpenADR 3 7, IEEE C37.118 synchrophasor (pypmu) 5, OPC UA binary (NodeSet structures) 3, OMA LwM2M 1, Sparkplug B 1. Networks: HL7 FHIR R4 146, OCSF 79, IETF packet headers 40, STIX 2.1 39, OpenConfig (RFC 7951 JSON) 24, IETF YANG data (RFC 7951 JSON) 19, OpenTelemetry OTLP 12, gNMI 8, IP flow export (IPFIX, NetFlow, sFlow) 7, IETF option areas 2, OpenC2 2, Prometheus remote write 2, Security event logs 2, BGP MRT 1, CACAO playbooks 1, CloudEvents 1, Elastic Common Schema 1. Maps, weather and alerts: aviationweather.gov Data API 18, NWS weather.gov API 18, OGC JSON encodings 15, OpenAQ API 15, Overture Maps 15, OGC I3S (Indexed 3D Scene Layers) 8, OGC CoverageJSON 3, Open311 GeoReport v2 3, OpenStreetMap PBF 3, NHC tropical cyclone status 2, USGS earthquake feed 2, CAP alerts 1, Garmin TCX 1, Geobuf 1, GeoJSON 1, GPX 1, KML 1, Mapbox Vector Tile 1, NASA EONET events 1, NOAA CO-OPS tides and currents 1, OGC Moving Features CSV 1, STAC Item 1, WMO WIS2 notification 1. Not shown: the 248 synthetic packs whose names start with conformance or demo-, which exercise the specification and stand for no real format.
svg.text: Every public format, by family: 141 families, 3,698 formats
Each tile is one family and the number of its packs in packs/, in 11 domains. The 248 synthetic
conformance and demo packs are not shown.
AOS, TC, TM, USLP, Proximity-1, CLCW, Space Packet, Encapsulation Packet, CFDP, CUC, CDS, CCS

icarous, loweheiser, marsh, paparazzi, stemstudios, storm32, uavionix
